learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the four beautiful seasons: Summer, Monsoon, Autumn, and Winter!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: It is very hot outside. We love to eat sweet ice cream and drink lots of water.
Plop plop! The rain falls from the sky. We use a colorful umbrella and splash in puddles.
The wind blows whoosh! The dry yellow leaves fall down from the big tall trees.
Brrr! It is so very cold. We wear cozy warm sweaters and drink hot milk.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Season Box
fun_activity.instructions: Look out of your window right now! Tell your mummy or papa which season it is today.

quick_recap: ⭐ Summer brings the hot yellow sun!
⭐ Monsoon brings the wet rainy clouds!
⭐ Autumn makes the brown leaves fall!
⭐ Winter brings the cold chilly days!
